lines: In these generated files gitleaks matches only rules that take any string of high entropy, which hashes and minified names are as well, or the curl lines a page of built documentation copies from its source, so the matches are not reported as secrets:
js/public/viewer/dicom-microscopy-viewer.bundle.891b86d0c0df9ca3fe6b.js, build output, as .gitignore says: 26 matches in what ships (generic-api-key).
js/public/viewer/dicomMicroscopyViewer.min.js, a minified file: 26 matches in what ships (generic-api-key).
js/public/viewer/app.bundle.ee902a9e2a37c08da432.js, build output, as .gitignore says: 25 matches in what ships (generic-api-key).
js/public/viewer/202.bundle.f972220da50d83e34c88.js, build output, as .gitignore says: 12 matches in what ships (generic-api-key).
A key a build takes from the environment ends up in such a file too: where one of them has no reason to carry a key, look at it.
